title: The Words of Agur

questions.question: Every word of God is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:5 (ESV): "Every word of God proves true;"

questions.question: He is a shield to those who take refuge in whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:5 (ESV): "he is a shield to those who take refuge in him."

questions.question: Remove far from me falsehood and lying; give me neither poverty nor what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:8 (ESV): "give me neither poverty nor riches;"

questions.question: Feed me with the food that is needful for me, lest I be full and do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:9 (ESV): "lest I be full and deny you and say, 'Who is the Lord?'"

questions.question: Or lest I be poor and steal and profane the name of my what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:9 (ESV): "and profane the name of my God."

questions.question: What are the four things that are small but exceedingly wise? Ants, rock badgers, locusts, and what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:28 (ESV): "the lizard you can take in your hands, yet it is in king's palaces."

questions.question: The ants are a people not strong, yet they provide their food in the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:25 (ESV): "yet they provide their food in the summer;"

questions.question: There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, "Enough": Sheol, the barren womb, the land never satisfied with water, and the what?
The eye that mocks a father and scorns to obey a mother will be picked out by the ravens of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:17 (ESV): "will be picked out by the ravens of the valley"

questions.question: If you have been foolish, exalting yourself, or if you have been devising evil, put your hand on your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:32 (ESV): "put your hand on your mouth."

questions.question: Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:4 (ESV): "Who has bound the waters in a garment?"

questions.question: Do not slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held what?
There are those who are clean in their own eyes but are not washed of their what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:12 (ESV): "but are not washed of their filth."

questions.question: The leech has two daughters: Give and what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:15 (ESV): "The leech has two daughters: Give and Give."

questions.question: Three things are stately in their tread; four are stately in their stride: the lion, the strutting rooster, the he-goat, and a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 30:31 (ESV): "and a king whose army is with him."

key_verse_text: Every word of God proves true; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
